location_description: Goshen ( GOH-shən) is a city in and the county seat of Elkhart County, Indiana, United States.  It is the smaller of the two principal cities of the Elkhart-Goshen Metropolitan Statistical Area, which in turn is part of the South Bend-Elkhart-Mishawaka Combined Statistical Area.  It is located in the northern part of Indiana near the Michigan border, in a region known as Michiana.
